Question:
Prepare a comprehensive performance report on our sellers, focusing on total sales, average item price, average review scores, and packing times. Ensure that the report includes only those sellers who have sold a quantity of more than 100 products and highlight the product category names in English with the highest sales volume.

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

SQL:
WITH seller_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_quantity,
        AVG(oi.price) as avg_item_price,
        AVG(or_.review_score) as avg_review_score,
        AVG(DATE(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) as avg_packing_days
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    LEFT JOIN order_reviews or_ ON oi.order_id = or_.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
category_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        pcnt.product_category_name_english,
        COUNT(*) as category_quantity
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pcnt ON p.product_category_name = pcnt.product_category_name
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id, pcnt.product_category_name_english
),
top_categories AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_id,
        product_category_name_english,
        category_quantity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seller_id ORDER BY category_quantity DESC) as rn
    FROM category_sales
)
SELECT 
    sm.seller_id,
    sm.total_quantity,
    sm.avg_item_price,
    sm.avg_review_score,
    sm.avg_packing_days,
    tc.product_category_name_english as top_category_english,
    tc.category_quantity as top_category_quantity
FROM seller_metrics sm
JOIN top_categories tc ON sm.seller_id = tc.seller_id AND tc.rn = 1
ORDER BY sm.total_quantity DESC

WITH seller_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_items_sold,
        AVG(oi.price) as avg_item_price,
        AVG(oh.review_score) as avg_review_score,
        AVG((CAST(o.order_delivered_carrier_date AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(o.order_approved_at AS TIMESTAMP))) as avg_packing_time
    FROM order_items oi
    LEFT JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    LEFT JOIN order_reviews oh ON oi.order_id = oh.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
seller_category_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        pcnt.product_category_name_english,
        COUNT(*) as category_sales
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pcnt ON p.product_category_name = pcnt.product_category_name
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id, pcnt.product_category_name_english
),
top_category_per_seller AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_id,
        product_category_name_english,
        category_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seller_id ORDER BY category_sales DESC) as rn
    FROM seller_category_sales
)
SELECT 
    ss.seller_id,
    ss.total_items_sold,
    ss.avg_item_price,
    ss.avg_review_score,
    ss.avg_packing_time,
    tcs.product_category_name_english as top_category,
    tcs.category_sales
FROM seller_stats ss
JOIN top_category_per_seller tcs ON ss.seller_id = tcs.seller_id AND tcs.rn = 1
ORDER BY ss.total_items_sold DESC
